### Which navigation layout should the app use?

- **A** — A top bar, as today
- **B** — A sidebar that collapses

> [!tip] Recommended
> B. The page keeps its width, and the menu is one tap away.

To choose: [open the options page](https://example.com/docs/design/nav-layout.html) · [read the record](decisions/nav-layout.md), then say which one.
